data.one_liner: A collection of animation widgets including ColorSonar, Sonar, HeartBeat, Fade, and Rotate.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use animation widgets such as ColorSonar, Sonar, HeartBeat, Fade, and Rotate to apply visual effects to child widgets. It aims to offer performance-optimized and efficient animation components for Flutter applications.
use_when: You want to quickly add pre-built animation effects like sonar waves, heartbeats, fading, or rotation to widgets.
You prefer using declarative animation widgets instead of writing custom AnimationController boilerplate.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based motion or low-level custom painter animations.
You require specific animations that are not yet included in the package collection.
strengths: Provides several common pre-built animation widgets out of the box.
Simple API requiring only an import and wrapping of child widgets.
weaknesses: Small initial collection of animation types compared to massive animation libraries.
